name: Korigad Fort
tagline: A short, family-friendly climb known for its monsoon wildflowers
seoTitle: Korigad Fort Solo Trek Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Korigad Fort near Lonavala — short beginner-friendly climb, monsoon wildflowers, safety, and packing.

seasons.label: Jun – Sep
seasons.sub: Monsoon — known for wildflower blooms on the approach

routeOptions.name: From Peth Shahapur
routeOptions.notes: Short, steady climb — one of the easiest fort treks on this list, good for a first Sahyadri outing.

safety.intro: Korigad is low-risk and well-trodden — a good confidence-building trek for new solo trekkers.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Good option if you're new to Sahyadri trekking and want a low-commitment first outing
Check for lake-level warnings — Korigad Lake on the plateau can flood in heavy rain

cards.title: On the trail
items: Path is well-marked and short — easy to self-navigate
Ramparts walk around the fort is worthwhile but mind the edges

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: Popular enough that you'll usually have company on the trail
Still tell someone your plan as a baseline habit
